title: कोशी कटानको त्रासमा श्रीलङ्का टप्पुका बासिन्दा
content:
सुनसरी। बराहक्षेत्र नगरपालिका–६ श्रीलङ्का टप्पुका बुद्धिमान माझीले सप्तकोशीको बाढी र कटानका कारण आफ्नो पाँच–सात बिघा जमिन गुमाइसकेका छन् । चार दशकदेखि श्रीलङ्का टप्पुमा बस्दै आएका माझीको अहिले आफ्नै नाममा जमिन समेत छैन । “कति बेला कोशी आउँछ र बगाउँछ भन्ने टुङ्गो हुँदैन, अहिले त्रासमा बस्नुपरेको छ,” उनले भने, “असार महिनादेखि नै कोशीले कटान सुरु ग¥यो अहिले पानी परेका बेला कहिले राति उठेर नदीमा ठूलो बाढी पो आएको छ कि भनेर हेर्न जान्छु । बेलुका सुत्न पनि डर लाग्छ, कहिलेकाहीँ जाग्राम नै बस्नुपर्छ ।”
पहिला वन्यजन्तुको समेत त्रास हुने गरेकोमा अहिले बत्ती जडान भएपछि त्यसमा केही कमी आए पनि कोशीको डुबान र कटानको जोखिम भने उस्तै रहेको उनले बताए । “अब यहाँबाट अन्तै सरेर जाऊँ भने पनि जाने ठाउँ छैन, खै के गर्ने,” उनले भने । हरेक वर्ष बर्खा सुरु भएसँगै देशका विभिन्न स्थानमा बाढी, पहिरो र डुबानका घटना दोहोरिन्छन् । अत्यधिक वर्षाका कारण ठूलो जनधनको क्षति हुने क्रम पनि जारी छ।
बाढी तथा डुबानको उच्च जोखिममध्येको सुनसरी जिल्ला पनि एक हो । बर्खायाममा सप्तकोशीसहित विभिन्न नदीमा आउने बाढीले बस्ती डुबानमा पार्ने र खेतीयोग्य जमिन बगाउने क्रम दोहोरिँदै आएको छ । सप्तकोशी नदी किनारका बस्तीका लागि बाढीसँगै नदीको तीव्र कटान पनि उत्तिकै ठूलो चुनौती बनेको छ । विशेषगरी बराहक्षेत्र नगरपालिका–६ र ९ स्थित चिलिया टप्पु तथा श्रीलङ्का टप्पुका बासिन्दा वर्षेनी बाढी र कटानको दोहोरो त्रासमा जीवन बिताउन बाध्य छन् । नदीले वर्षेनी खेतीयोग्य जमिन र बस्ती कटान गर्दै जोखिम बढाइरहे पनि यसको दीर्घकालीन समाधान हुन सकेको छैन ।
बर्खा सुरु भएसँगै सप्तकोशीको बहाव बढ्दा सुनसरी र उदयपुरको सिमानामा पर्ने श्रीलङ्का टप्पुका बासिन्दाको चिन्ता पनि बढ्ने गरेको छ । बराहक्षेत्र नगरपालिका–६ का पदम राई भन्छन, ‘‘हामी यहाँ पहिला पहाडबाट बसाइँ सरेर आउँदा कोशी नदी बस्तीबाट धेरै टाढा बग्ने गरेको थियो । अहिले भने नदी बस्ती नजिकै आइपुगेको छ ।’’ २०७४ सालदेखि सपरिवार श्रीलङ्का टप्पुमा बस्दै आउनु भएका राईले एक बिघा जमिनमा धान र मकै खेती गर्नुका साथै गाईभैँसी पालेर जीविकोपार्जन गर्दै आएका छन् । वर्षभरि मिहेनत गरेर खेतीपाती र पशुपालन गरे पनि हरेक वर्ष कोशीको कटान र बाढीले घर तथा खेत जोखिममा पार्ने गरेको उनले बताए ।
तीन महिनादेखि नै कटान सुरु भएको छ । हामी सबै मिलेर श्रमदान गर्दै बालुवा र सिमेन्टका बोरा भरेर किनार जोगाउने प्रयास गरिरहेका छौँ । उनले भने, ‘‘तर ठूलो बाढी आयो भने यो प्रयासले धान्न सक्दैन । अहिलेका लागि केही राहत भए पनि यो स्थायी समाधान होइन ।’’ वर्षभरको खेतीपाती र पशुपालनबाट परिवारको गुजारा चल्ने भए पनि हरेक बर्खामा बाढी र कटानले आफूहरूको मिहेनत बगाइदिने हो कि भन्ने चिन्ता रहने गरेको उनले सुनाए ।
कोशीले तीव्र कटान गर्न थालेपछि स्थानीयवासी, नेपाल प्रहरी, सशस्त्र प्रहरी, नेपाली सेना तथा नगर प्रहरी संयुक्त रूपमा श्रमदान गरी अस्थायी तटबन्ध निर्माण गर्दै बस्ती जोगाउने प्रयास जारी छ । सप्तकोशी कटान नियन्त्रण समितिका अध्यक्ष जयकुमार माझीका अनुसार वर्षेनी बढ्दो कटानका कारण चिलिया टप्पु र श्रीलङ्का टप्पुको बस्ती उच्च जोखिममा पर्दै गएको छ।
कटान नियन्त्रणका लागि यसअघि निर्माण गरिएका करिब १८ वटा स्परमध्ये नौ वटा पूर्ण रूपमा क्षतिग्रस्त भइसकेका छन् भने बाँकी स्परसमेत नदीको कटानमा पर्दै गएका छन् । “बराहक्षेत्र नगरपालिका र उदयपुरको बेलका नगरपालिकाको समन्वयमा श्रमदान गरेर कटान रोक्ने प्रयास गरिरहेका छौँ,”उनले भने, “बाँस गाड्ने, नाइलनको डोरीले बाँध्ने र बालुवा भरिएका बोरा राख्ने जस्ता उपाय अपनाएका छौँ । तर यी तत्कालका लागि अस्थायी उपाय मात्र हुन् । दीर्घकालीन रूपमा बलियो तटबन्ध निर्माण नगरी समस्या समाधान हुन सक्दैन ।”
सप्तकोशीले धार परिवर्तन गरेर बनाएको चिलिया टापु अहिले पनि हजारौँ मानिसको आश्रयस्थल हो । बराहक्षेत्र नगरपालिका–६ र ९ तथा उदयपुरको बेलका नगरपालिका–१, २ र ३ मा फैलिएको यस क्षेत्रमा हरेक बर्खासँगै नदीको बहाव बढ्ने गरेको छ । यसवर्ष पनि चिलिया र गरैया क्षेत्रमा नदीले तीव्र कटान थालेपछि सयौँ परिवार त्रासमा बाँचिरहेका छन् ।
सप्तकोशीको पश्चिमी भँगालोले धार परिवर्तन गर्दै निरन्तर कटान गरेपछि अहिले ६०० घरपरिवार उच्च जोखिममा छन् भने केही दिनअघि करिब २२ घरपरिवारलाई सुरक्षित स्थानमा सारिएको थियो । केही परिवार अहिले पनि चौरमा टहरामा बसिरहेका छन् । बराहक्षेत्र नगरपालिका–६ का बद्रीकुमार राईका अनुसार भारत सरकारले अघिल्लो वर्ष ढुङ्गाको जाली लगाएर निर्माण गरिदिएको ‘स्पर’ हुँदाहुँदै पनि कोशीले कटान गरेको छ । बराहक्षेत्र–९ तर्फ भने यस्ता स्परसमेत नभएकाले नदीको कटान अझ तीव्र भइरहेको उनले बताए ।
बराहक्षेत्र नगरपालिका–६ श्रीलङ्का टप्पुका राकेशकुमार महतोको करिब चार बिघा जग्गा सप्तकोशी नदीको कटानले बगाएपछि उनी अहिले अरूको जग्गा भाडामा लिएर तरकारी खेती गरिरहेका छन् । महतोले अहिले करिब १० कट्ठा जग्गा भाडामा लिएर टमाटर, बोडी, साग, भिन्डीलगायत मौसमी तरकारी खेती गरेका छन् । त्यसमध्ये आठ कट्ठामा मल्चिङ प्रविधिबाट गोलभेँडा खेती गरिएको छ भने बाँकी जग्गामा विभिन्न मौसमी तरकारी लगाइएको उनले बताए ।
“पहिला करिब चार बिघा जग्गा थियो । सबै सप्तकोशी नदीले कटान गरेर लग्यो । अहिले आफ्नो जग्गा छैन, अरूको जग्गा भाडामा लिएर तरकारी खेती गरिरहेको छु,” महतोले भने, “पहिला बारी धेरै हुँदा तरकारी खेतीसँगै गाईभैँसी पनि पाल्थेँ । कोसी कटानले खेतीयोग्य जमिन बगाएपछि पशुपालनका लागि आवश्यक चरन गर्ने ठाउँ पनि छैन । अहिले गाईभैँसी पाल्न पनि छाडेको छु ।” अहिले तरकारीसँगै धान र मकै खेती गरेर जीविकोपार्जन गरिरहेको उनले बताए । “बर्सेनि सप्तकोशीले कटान गरिरहेको छ । अहिले बसिरहेको यो सानो बास र टिनले बारेर बनाएको कटेरो घर पनि कुन दिन कोशीले बगाएर लैजाला भन्ने डर छ,” उनले भने।
बर्खा सुरु भएपछि श्रीलङ्का टप्पुका बासिन्दाले हरेक वर्ष बाढी र कटानको त्रास भोग्दै आएका छन् । बर्सेनि खेतीयोग्य जमिन साँघुरिँदै जानु, घर नजिकै नदी आइपुग्नु र आवश्यक पर्दा बस्ती नै छाडेर हिँड्नुपर्ने अवस्था दोहोरिँदा यहाँका नागरिकका लागि बर्खायाम चिन्ताको विषय बन्ने गरेको छ । वर्षभरको खेतीपाती र पशुपालनबाट परिवारको गुजारा चल्ने भए पनि प्रत्येक वर्ष बर्खामा बाढी र कटानले सबै मिहेनत बगाइदिने चिन्ता स्थानीयलाई उस्तै रहने गरेको छ ।
उदयपुरको बेलका नगरपालिकाका नगरप्रमुख अशोक कार्कीका अनुसार बेलका–८ क्षेत्रमा गरिएको संरक्षण कार्यले केही राहत दिएको भए पनि तल्लोतटीय क्षेत्रमा नदीको कटान रोकिएको छैन । सप्तकोशीले बिस्तारै धार पश्चिमतर्फ मोड्ने संकेत देखिएको र त्यहाँ बाक्लो मानव बस्ती रहेकाले जोखिम झन् बढ्दै गएको उनले बताए । गत वर्ष कटान रोक्ने उद्देश्यले निर्माण गरिएका तारजालीयुक्त संरचनासमेत अहिले नदीको बहावमा डुब्न थालेका छन् । असारदेखि सुरु भएको कटान अब झन् बढ्दै जाने खतरा रहेको छ । बलौटे माटो भएकाले दैनिक रूपमा जमिन बगिरहेको छ भने संरक्षणका लागि राखिएका ढुङ्गा र तारजाली नदीले बगाउँदै लगेको छ ।
बराहक्षेत्र नगरपालिकाका प्रमुख रमेश कार्की भन्छन्, “कटान रोक्न नगरपालिकाले आफ्नो क्षमताअनुसार आवश्यक सबै स्रोतसाधन परिचालन गरेको छ ।” कटान प्रभावित क्षेत्रमा जेसिबी, ट्याक्टर, बालुवा ढुवानीका साधन, जाली, बोरा, सिमेन्टलगायत आवश्यक सामग्री उपलब्ध गराएर स्थानीय र सुरक्षा निकायसँग समन्वय गरी तटबन्ध निर्माण तथा कटान नियन्त्रणको काम भइरहेको उनले बताए ।
कोशी कटानपछि विस्थापित परिवारलाई बराहक्षेत्र नगरपालिकाले तत्कालका लागि प्रतिपरिवार रु १० हजार उपलब्ध गराएको छ । नगरप्रमुख कार्कीले भने, “कोशीको कटान यहाँको मात्र समस्या नभई राष्ट्रिय सरोकारको विषय हो । नगरपालिकाको सीमित बजेट र स्रोत साधनले बर्सेनि दोहोरिने कटानको स्थायी समाधान सम्भव छैन । हामीले आफ्नो तर्फबाट गर्न सकिने सबै प्रयास गरिरहेका छौँ । तर सप्तकोशी जस्तो शक्तिशाली नदी नियन्त्रणका लागि वैज्ञानिक अध्ययनका आधारमा दीर्घकालीन संरचना निर्माण गर्न आवश्यक छ ।”
उपयुक्त स्थानमा ड्याम, स्पर तथा अन्य नदी नियन्त्रणका संरचना निर्माण गर्न सकिए कटान धेरै हदसम्म नियन्त्रण गर्न सकिने उनको भनाइ छ । “यदि कटान बढ्दै गएर बस्तीमा बाढी पस्यो भने ठूलो धनजनको क्षति हुन सक्छ । दीर्घकालीन समाधानका लागि सङ्घीय सरकारको सहयोग, पर्याप्त बजेट र आवश्यक परे छिमेकी मुलुकसँग कूटनीतिक पहलसमेत आवश्यक छ,” नगरप्रमुख कार्कीले भने ।
कोशीले निरन्तर कटान गर्न थालेपछि श्रीलङ्का टप्पुका केही बासिन्दा यस वर्ष सप्तकोसीपारि पूर्वतर्फको प्रकाशपुरमा बसाइँ सरिसकेका छन् । केही परिवार भने वर्षौंदेखि बस्दै आएको ठाउँ छाडेर झापा बसाइँ गएका छन् । श्रीलङ्का टप्पुका बालीचरण कविरथ पनि प्रकाशपुर सर्ने तयारीमा छन् । “धन्न जसोतसो गरेर प्रकाशपुरमा एक कठ्ठा जग्गा जोडिएको छ । अब हामी पनि त्यतै सर्ने तयारी गर्दैछौँ । यहाँ कोसीले कटान गरिरहेको छ, ज्यान जोखिममा राखेर बस्नु हुँदैन,” उनले भने ।
करिब तीन हजार जनसङ्ख्या रहेको यस क्षेत्रमा अधिकांश परिवारको जीविकोपार्जन कृषि र पशुपालनमा आधारित छ । धान, मकै, तरकारी खेती, पशुपालन तथा दुग्ध उत्पादन यहाँको ग्रामीण अर्थतन्त्रका मुख्य आधार हुन् । हरेक बर्खामा बाढी र कटानको जोखिमसँग जुध्दै स्थानीयले श्रमदान गरेर अस्थायी तटबन्ध निर्माण तथा सामूहिक पहलमार्फत बस्ती र खेतीयोग्य जमिन जोगाउने प्रयास गर्दै आएका छन् । तर यस्ता प्रयासले तत्काल केही राहत दिए पनि दीर्घकालीन समाधान हुन सकेको छैन । रासस

title: Liège : la bibliothèque d’Angleur se pare de nouvelles couleurs grâce à de nouvelles fresques
content:
Liège : la bibliothèque d'Angleur se pare de nouvelles couleurs grâce à de nouvelles fresques
À Angleur, les habitants ont mis la main à la mosaïque. La bibliothèque s'offre un nouveau décor après près d'un an de travail collectif.
- Publié le 19-09-2026 à 19h00
À Angleur, les murs de la bibliothèque ont désormais un nouveau visage. Des fresques en mosaïque, réalisées collectivement par des habitants, des élèves et des enfants participant aux stages de la Ville de Liège, ont été inaugurées, il y a quelques jours. Un projet participatif qui aura mobilisé le quartier pendant plusieurs mois.
Entre octobre 2025 et août 2026, habitants d'Angleur et de Liège, élèves de l'école fondamentale communale Andréa Jadoulle et enfants des stages de la Ville de Liège ont mis la main à la pâte pour donner naissance à ces œuvres. Leur objectif : apporter de la couleur aux abords de la bibliothèque, tout en associant directement les habitants à la transformation de leur quartier.
Le projet a été porté par le Centre culturel Ourthe et Meuse, en partenariat avec la bibliothèque d'Angleur, l'école Andréa Jadoulle et les différents participants. Il a également bénéficié du soutien des services culturels et techniques de la Ville de Liège.
Près d'un an de travail collectif
Au fil des mois, les participants ont travaillé à la réalisation des mosaïques, dans une démarche mêlant différentes générations. L'inauguration a permis de découvrir le résultat de ce travail et de réunir habitants, partenaires et participants autour d'un moment festif.
La cérémonie a notamment été animée par le groupe vocal Polyfunny, dirigé par Marie Zinnen. Les échanges entre les participants ont prolongé cette dimension conviviale, au cœur d'un projet qui entendait autant embellir les lieux que favoriser les rencontres.
Ces nouvelles fresques viennent aussi renforcer la place de la bibliothèque comme lieu de culture et de vie dans le quartier.
Une nouvelle édition dès octobre
L'initiative s'inscrit dans la continuité des "Journées mosaïque", lancées à la suite des inondations de juillet 2021. Le projet vise depuis lors à créer du lien entre les habitants tout en intervenant directement dans l'espace public.
L'histoire ne s'arrête d'ailleurs pas avec cette inauguration. Une nouvelle édition des Journées mosaïque est annoncée dès le mois d'octobre. Ouverte à toutes et tous, elle permettra à nouveau aux habitants de participer à la création d'œuvres collectives appelées à prendre place dans l'espace public angleurois.
Les fresques constituent ainsi un nouveau repère dans le quartier, fruit d'un travail associant habitants, école, acteurs culturels et services publics

title: Brazil Is Going Federal. The U.S. Went State by State. Which Model Gives Consumers Clearer Safeguards?
content: Brazil has moved from a largely emerging framework toward a national system for fixed-odds wagering, giving consumers a single federal reference point. Law 14,790 of 2023 established the core framework, as the Ministry of Finance's Secretariat of Prizes and Betting became responsible for authorization, supervision and enforcement. From January 2025, only federally authorized companies can operate nationally, creating a clearer baseline for consumers nationally in practice. That provides consistency.

title: Western Australia is experiencing a child safety crisis. Here’s what would help
content:
One of Australia’s most resource-rich regions, South Hedland in Western Australia, sits alongside a mining industry generating enormous wealth. This is in stark contrast to persistent social and economic disadvantage affecting parts of the local community, particularly among Aboriginal residents.
Much of this disadvantage has made headlines recently. Multiple media outlets are reporting a child safety crisis has emerged in the area.
Reports have focused on local tragedies, including the deaths of three children in 2022, and revelations about a reported “hellhole house” in Frisby Court where up to 15 children have reportedly been living with no adult supervision, in squalid conditions.
But the language of crisis implies something unexpectedly sudden. It suggests we were unaware of the issues, or what was needed to address them.
Yet Aboriginal women in the Pilbara were describing the conditions placing children at risk six years ago. They also offered solutions, but the response has not matched the level of need.
Dire warnings
In 2020, Aboriginal women told us about concerns in South Hedland. Throughout the Pilbara, Aboriginal women spoke to the Australian Human Rights Commission as part of the Wiyi Yani U Thangani (Women’s Voices) project, led by former Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Social Justice Commissioner June Oscar.
South Hedland women described substance abuse, family and domestic violence, mental health concerns, racism, unemployment and housing issues.
They also spoke about children’s safety being compromised at times, with girls sometimes running away and wandering the streets alone.
Women in South Hedland called for practical responses, including a holistic healing centre for men who perpetrate violence and better access to substance abuse services. They described bureaucracy and waiting periods as barriers to treatment at the point where someone was ready to seek help.
While there has been some investment in the Pilbara since 2020, services are working in an extraordinarily complex environment, often with high demand and workforce pressures. Nowhere is this more evident than in child protection.
In 2024–25, 12,529 children were the subject of child protection investigations in Western Australia. About 41% of these concerned First Nations children.
More than half of the total investigations concerned children who had previously been involved with the system. This is a pattern evident nationally.
Repeated child protection involvement indicates substantial and persistent family need. It also highlights the limits of expecting the statutory child protection system to resolve these problems alone.
Is removal the best option?
Across Australia, families coming to the attention of child protection authorities are experiencing multiple, often overlapping challenges. These include family and domestic violence, mental health concerns, substance abuse, housing instability, poverty and unemployment.
While some may believe the answer lies in more child removals, evidence shows removal can create new risks and harms. For Aboriginal children, child removal also repeats the destructive cycle of disconnection from family, culture and community.
This is not to say that removal should never occur. Rather, with appropriate and accessible support, parents can often address concerns before they escalate, while extended family can step in where additional care is needed.
Sophisticated child safety responses must go beyond child protective services. Keeping children safe requires early, targeted support alongside practical and therapeutic responses to the reasons children end up in the protection system. The earlier these supports are provided, the greater the chance of success.
There are solutions
Recent events demand scrutiny and accountability. But tragedies in child protection also create a risk of policy being driven by outrage and the court of public opinion.
Aboriginal children’s safety matters. That we can all agree on. But how we achieve that safety requires a nuanced, considered approach, consistent with evidence and local, on-the-ground expertise from people living in their communities.
If the concerns for Aboriginal children’s safety are genuine, then the response must act on Aboriginal solutions, rather than imposing solutions on families and communities.
Aboriginal community-controlled organisations have demonstrated what is possible when appropriately resourced.
The Victorian Aboriginal Child and Community Agency has trialled an Aboriginal-led initiative to safely divert families away from the child protection system. The program achieved a 78% diversion rate.
Rather than close the report and wait for the next one, families were offered support to address the issues bringing them to child protection’s attention. This success demonstrates that Aboriginal solutions work.
Family-led decision-making offers another avenue. Evidence from South Australia indicates family decision-making can reduce substantiated child maltreatment and entry into out-of-home care.
WA has already taken steps in this direction. Yet five years after the Aboriginal Family-Led Decision-Making pilot began, it remains limited to two areas and is unavailable in the Pilbara.
The WA government’s commitment of $7.2 million over four years to continue the pilot represents important progress. However, there is an opportunity to expand it across Western Australia alongside greater investment in services families need before reaching crisis point.
Keeping children safe requires governments to invest in the conditions that make safety possible. No family decision-making forum can manufacture a house that doesn’t exist, a rehabilitation bed that is unavailable, or a mental health service that cannot be accessed.
We do not need another tragedy to tell us what Aboriginal communities need. They have already told us. It’s time we started listening, and acting on it.

title: Majka i troje djece poginuli u požaru u Engleskoj
content:
Majka i troje djece poginuli u tragičnom požaru kod Liverpoola
OBITELJ majke i troje djece koji su poginuli u požaru obiteljske kuće opisala je svoj gubitak kao "nezamisliv". Elisha Brabin (36) i njezina djeca Leo (16), Ellis (8) i Prudence (7) preminuli su nakon što se vatra jučer rano ujutro brzo proširila njihovom kućom na trgu Stone Square u Bootleu kod Liverpoola, u regiji Merseyside. Točan uzrok požara još se istražuje.
Izjava obitelji
Članovi obitelji odali su počast stradalima i poručili da su shrvani te da će se posljedice ovog gubitka "osjećati zauvijek". U priopćenju su naveli da je "Elisha bila predana i brižna majka", a da su njihova "divna djeca, Leo, Ellis i Prudence, bila neizmjerno voljena".
"Shrvani smo gubitkom Elishe, Lea, Ellisa i Prudence", stoji u izjavi. "Elisha je bila naša voljena kći, supruga, majka, sestra, teta, nećakinja i sestrična. Bila je predana majka koja je živjela za svoju djecu. Oni su bili cijeli njezin svijet, a nama je značila sve."
U izjavi se dalje navodi: "Naša divna djeca, Leo, Ellis i Prudence, bila su neizmjerno voljena i donijela su toliko radosti, sreće i ljubavi u našu obitelj. Ispunili su nam živote smijehom i dragocjenim uspomenama koje ćemo zauvijek čuvati."
"Tragični gubitak Elishe i naše troje dragocjene djece potpuno nas je slomio. Svi su nam oduzeti prerano. Gubitak koji proživljavamo je nezamisliv, a posljedice će naša obitelj osjećati zauvijek." Obitelj je zamolila za privatnost dok tuguju. "Željeli bismo zahvaliti svima na ljubaznosti, podršci i razumijevanju", poručili su.
Reakcije zajednice
Počast stradalima odali su i susjedi te prijatelji. Rachel, koja je odrasla u blizini stradale majke, rekla je za BBC: "Usrećivala je svoju djecu, sve je radila za njih." Dodala je: "Bili su voljeni. Ovo je stvarno, stvarno tužno."
Nakon što je ostavila cvijeće blizu policijske ograde oko trga, izjavila je: "Čak i da je nisam poznavala, svejedno bih došla odati počast jer su mala djeca izgubila živote, kao i njihova majka. Ovo je razorilo cijelu obitelj."
Loti Nambombe, koji se nakon požara brine o obiteljskom psu, rekao je: "Mi smo zajednica. Slomljeni smo. Ovo boli." Nambombe je pokrenuo internetsku stranicu za prikupljanje pomoći za obitelj, na kojoj je do srijede prikupljeno više od 5000 funti. "Svi samo žele nekako pomoći, to je naša dužnost kao susjeda i kao zajednice", kazao je.
Nambombe je ispričao kako su stanovnici istrčali na ulicu čim su čuli vrištanje nakon izbijanja požara. "Neki od ljudi ovdje su pravi heroji. Pokušavali su utrčati unutra, donijeti ljestve ili razbiti prozore kako bi izvukli stanare. Ljudi su riskirali vlastite živote pokušavajući pomoći", rekao je.
Gradonačelnik šireg područja Liverpoola Steve Rotheram u razgovoru za BBC Radio Merseyside komentirao je situaciju. "U zajednicama o kojima govorimo postoji snažna povezanost, posebno u Bootleu i sličnim mjestima, to je vrlo, vrlo snažan identitet. Siguran sam da će zajednica učiniti sve što može kako bi pomogla ostatku obitelji", izjavio je.

title: How a cascade dating back to the 1690s is being fixed
content:
How a cascade dating back to the 1690s is being fixed
- Published
The 23 steps that make up the cascade at Chatsworth House have been the centrepiece of the stately home's garden for more than 325 years.
But over the centuries, leakage through its stones began to impact the tunnels underneath it and put the water feature at "significant structural risk".
It was turned off in 2024 to prevent further damage and possible collapse, but now a major restoration project has begun there.
Jane Marriott, director of Chatsworth House Trust - the charity that cares for the historic estate - said when ground was broken on the restoration work on Wednesday, there was a feeling of "a bit of relief, excitement, but also a real sense of gratitude".
Marriott said: "It's the culmination of years of work. Two years ago we switched the water off running down the cascade because it was at threat of collapsing.
"A year before that, we'd gone to the lottery to ask them for support to restore it.
"We're at the stage where we've actually been able to lift the first stone, break ground and start the work on the restoration.
"Without the support of the charity to make this possible, without the partners who have worked with us, the incredible volunteers, we wouldn't have been able to do this."
The cascade sits at the heart of Chatsworth's famous gardens in Derbyshire, fed by water from the hillside above the estate running down towards Salisbury Lawn outside the house.
The Grade I-listed landmark was built in 1696 and is "a significant feat of engineering and nature-inspired design that has delighted generations of visitors", according to Chatsworth House Trust.
It includes a temple housing 13 fountains, from which water normally runs down over 23 different shaped and textured giant stone steps, each formed of more than 100 individual stones.
Work to these is now able to begin as the appeal has passed £5m of a £7.2m fundraising campaign.
Robert Harrison, head of operations at Chatsworth House, said each stone would be individually lifted.
"We know the cascade has failed and water's been running under it," he said.
"We're going to test every single stone to see if we can reuse it, hopefully we can, if we can't we'll be replacing it with a new stone from Burntwood Quarry, our own quarry only two miles up the hill."
The tunnel beneath the cascade is also being shored up, re-dug around the pipe work, and repointed.
Harrison said the project was expected to take between a year and 18 months to complete with the water back on in 2028.
Funding for the restoration includes a £4.6m grant from the National Lottery Heritage Fund.
The fund's East Midlands chairman Julian Glover added: "We need to bring it alive again for the future, and we need to bring water back to it.
"We need to see it adored as it always has been."

title: Le roi Philippe a reçu 12 "héros du quotidien" au Palais (PHOTOS)
content:
Le roi Philippe a reçu 12 "héros du quotidien" au Palais (PHOTOS)
Le roi Philippe a reçu en audience, jeudi après-midi, douze citoyens mis en lumière par l'initiative BeHeroes portée par le Fonds Prince Philippe, géré par la Fondation Roi Baudouin. Ces douze "héros du quotidien" ont été sélectionnés pour leur engagement en faveur d'une société meilleure.
- Publié le 17-09-2026 à 19h53
- Mis à jour le 17-09-2026 à 19h54
Pour cette 7e édition, les citoyens étaient invités à désigner leurs "héros du quotidien" sur le site de l'opération. Près de 150 candidatures ont été introduites à travers le pays. Un jury indépendant a sélectionné 50 BeHeroes, aux profils et parcours très divers. Après avoir assisté au défilé de la fête nationale depuis la tribune officielle le 21 juillet dernier, douze d'entre eux ont eu l'honneur de rencontrer le Roi lors d'une audience collective.
Alexandre Hemelaer, un Ucclois de 26 ans, était le plus jeune BeHero présent. Il a fondé il y a deux ans "Tigerstorm", l'un des quatre clubs de Powerchair Football en Belgique, une discipline qui permet aux personnes en situation de handicap de jouer au football à l'aide d'un fauteuil roulant électrique.
Toujours en matière de handicap, l'engagement de Patrick Gerardy (68 ans, Knokke), co-fondateur de l'ASBL "Un monde meilleur" a également été salué, ainsi que celui de Lies Gielis (37 ans, Laakdal), atteinte d'un handicap intellectuel et qui accompagne bénévolement une classe maternelle depuis 19 ans, et de Saskia Benus (68 ans), qui œuvre pour l'emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.
La résilience était également au cœur des profils sélectionnés. Aminata Kamate, (31 ans, Bruxelles) a fondé l'ASBL Fondation Kalifa afin de sensibiliser à la drépanocytose, dont son petit frère Kalifa est décédé et dont elle est elle-même atteinte. Julien Vande Weyer, assistant social de 33 ans au CHU Saint-Pierre a été grièvement poignardé par un patient sur son lieu de travail et a alors décidé de se mobiliser en lançant la campagne 'Un pas, un toit!' au profit de l'organisation Infirmiers de rue. Evelien Maerten (43 ans, Gand) accompagne quant à elle les personnes en deuil après avoir perdu son mari.
Parmi les autres profils se trouvent Mahamat Haroun (68 ans, Jette), co-fondateur de l'ASBL Friendly Foot; Cynthia Simpson (60 ans, Braine-l'Alleud), fondatrice de l'ASBL Solidarité Grands Froids; Karine Vanommeslaeghe (54 ans, Eupen), co-fondatrice de LichtBLICKE; le Père Karel Stautemas (62 ans, Grimbergen), qui organise des convois humanitaires vers l'Ukraine, ainsi que Burak Köylü (29 ans, Gand) qui s'investit au sein d'Actief vzw.

title: VIDEO Tronsonul blestemat de pe Autostrada Transilvania, aproape de finalizare. Cum arată acum cel mai complex pod început de Bechtel și abandonat apoi mulți ani
content:
VIDEO Tronsonul blestemat de pe Autostrada Transilvania, aproape de finalizare. Cum arată acum cel mai complex pod început de Bechtel și abandonat apoi mulți ani
Aproape 98% din suprafața traseului este deja asfaltată, anunță constructorul român care lucrează la finalizarea unui tronson din Autostrada Transilvania ce a fost abandonat de Bechtel și a rămas aproape neatins timp de 12 ani.
O structură-mamut a fost ridicată de Bechtel în Transilvania, peste un lac de acumulare, însă ea n-a fost finalizată niciodată și a rămas neatinsă timp de 12 ani. Acum, în sfârșit, e aproape de finalizare și deschidere.
Odată deschiși traficului, cei aproape 27 de kilometri vor fi legați de un alt tronson de aproape 14 km deschiși traficului în 2023.
Dacă vă faceți în septembrie un abonament anual la HotNews Premium, un profesor primește gratuit un abonament pe 12 luni.
Abonamentele dascălilor sunt distribuite prin două organizații de educație care investesc în profesori.
„Pe lotul Suplacu de Barcău – Chiribiș al Autostrăzii Transilvania, 98% din suprafața traseului este deja asfaltată. Un procent care arată cât de mult s-a schimbat acest traseu și cât de aproape este de forma sa finală”, a transmis constructorul român Construcții Erbașu.
Asociația Pro Infrastructura, care a filmat din dreonă tot tronsonul, estimează că „probabil în noiembrie circulăm pe Autostrada A3 între Suplacu și Chiribiș”.
În întârziere față de termenul contractual
„Chiar dacă finalul lunii octombrie teoretic este posibil, inaugurarea celor 26,35 kilometri dintre Suplacu de Barcău și Chiribiș se va face în noiembrie. Rămânem cu un gust amar fiindcă antreprenorul Erbașu putea mai mult. Întârzierea față de termenul contractual din iulie 2026 nu este mare dar devine vizibilă. S-au pierdut câteva luni și în perioada de proiectare. Deși la începutul șantierului mobilizarea a fost foarte bună, ulterior constructorul a scăzut ritmul, în special în punctele critice din zona Porț-Suplacu de Barcău”, susține Pro Infrastructura, una din cele mai active organizații civice care monitorizează marile proecte de infrastructură din țară.
„Acum avem asfalt peste tot, mai puțin pe o secțiune de terasament în apropiere de culeea sudică a viaductului de la Suplacu de Barcău și la conexiunea „semi-nod” de lângă Porț/Marca. Singura structură rămasă în urmă este pasajul peste A3 din zona câmpului de sonde care nu este critică pentru inaugurare, dacă se dorește darea în trafic mai repede”, susține API.
Organizația spune că și tronsonul „vecin” spre Biharia „are șanse bune să se deschidă în decembrie. Ambele sunt reminiscențe de pe vremea Bechtel. Americanii au dat prima cupă de excavator în urmă cu 22 de ani, în iunie 2004! Erbașu este al patrulea constructor de pe acest tronson!”.
Continuarea de la Suplacău de Barcău la Nușfalău – cei 13,5 km – a fost deschisă traficului în 2023.
De ce a fost construit un viaduct de aproape 2 kilometri prin mijlocul unui lac
Tronsonul dintre Chiribiș și Suplacu de Barcău este cunoscut și pentru o structură-mamut care a fost ridicată de Bechtel peste un lac de acumulare și care a zăcut ani de zile fără a mai fi terminată.
Viaductul are 45 de deschideri a câte 40 de metri lungime fiecare și decizia de a fi construit prin lacul de acumulare a fost una controversată la timpul ei.
Autostrada Transilvania în zona Suplacu de Barcău urma să treacă printr-un câmp activ de sonde petroliere, iar în anii 2000 în zona lacului nu era foarte multă apă.
Pentru a reloca cât mai puține sonde și pentru a evita un deal mai înalt în zona vestică, a fost stabilit traseul autostrăzii prin zona lacului de acumulare, considerându-se atunci că e cea mai ieftină dintre soluții disponibile.
De ce i se spune „tronsonul blestemat” din Autostrada Transilvania
Tronsonul Suplacu de Barcău – Chiribiș a fost supranumit de-a lungul anilor „tronsonul blestemat”, pentru că deși fusese cel mai avansat ca lucrări dintre cele abandonate de Bechtel, acesta nu a putut fi gata. Fie autoritățile nu au putut demara procedurile în timp util, fie a dat peste constructori ce nu și-au putut onora contractele.
Proiectul de la Suplacu de Barcău la Chiribiș (și mai departe până la Borș) fusese abandonat în 2013, când ministrul PSD de atunci Dan Șova a decis rezilierea contractului cu Bechtel. Tronsonul fusese construit aproape 50%, inclusiv o mare parte din celebrul viaduct de 1,8 km de la Suplacu de Barcău peste lacul de acumulare cu același nume.
Ulterior, CNAIR a scos la licitație proiectul, l-a contractat în 2015 cu o asociere spaniolă (Corsan – Corviam Construccion – SA & SC Consinit SRL & SC Road Consulting & Design Solution SRL & SC Via Design SRL) pe circa 701 milioane de lei, dar în 2016 l-a reziliat din cauza mobilizării slabe a constructorului.
Apoi, abia în decembrie 2020 a fost relansat la licitație proiectul Suplacu de Barcău – Chiribiș, în martie 2021 au fost depuse patru oferte, iar în septembrie 2021 a fost desemnat un câștigător – Construcții Erbașu – Vahostav – SK A.S., ofertă de 542 mil lei. S-au depus contestații, iar apoi licitația nu s-a mai finalizat cu un contract semnat.
În iulie 2022, fostul ministru Cătălin Drulă acuza conducerea de atunci de la Transporturi că au anulat licitația, deși ministrul Grindeanu anunța atunci pe Facebook că ofertele sunt la reevaluare și că se va da un câștigător până în august. În cele din urmă licitația chiar a fost anulată și meciul mai apoi s-a mutat în instanțe, pe contestarea deciziei de anulare.
În noiembrie 2023 era în sfârșit contractată din nou finalizarea contractului. La acel moment se făceau 11 ani de când Bechtel a părăsea șantierul.
Contractul Bechtel
Numele Bechtel a devenit cunoscut în România după un contract uriaș de infrastructură care a eșuat răsunător și a făcut chiar și obiectul unui dosar penal.
În 2003 România semna un contract cu firma americană Bechtel pentru construirea Autostrăzii Transilvania de la Brașov până la Borș, un proiect atribuit fără licitație și marcat de costuri uriașe și întârzieri majore.
După aproape un deceniu, statul a plătit peste un miliard de euro pentru doar aproximativ 50 de kilometri finalizați între Turda și Gilău (la vest de Cluj Napoca) și alți 64 de kilometri realizați doar pe jumătate, între Suplacu de Barcău și Borș.

title: USA: Gefängnisse in Texas müssen Klimaanlagen bekommen
content:
»Keine menschenwürdigen Haftbedingungen« Gefängnisse in Texas müssen Klimaanlagen bekommen
Zehntausende Häftlinge im US-Bundesstaat Texas sollen in den kommenden Jahren besser vor extremer Hitze geschützt werden. Ein Bundesrichter in der Stadt Austin ordnete an, dass Gefängnisse des flächenmäßig größten Bundesstaates bis Ende 2029 mit Klimaanlagen ausgestattet werden müssen. Fast 90.000 Insassen hätten ihre Strafen im vergangenen Sommer in Zellen ohne Klimaanlage absitzen müssen, teilte das Gericht mit .
Richter Robert Pitman begründete seine Entscheidung damit, dass die Temperaturen in Texas auf mehr als 50 Grad Celsius ansteigen können. »Insassen in texanischen Gefängnissen leiden – und sterben in manchen Fällen – jeden Sommer an extremer Hitze«, hieß es.
Zeugen hätten vor Gericht ausgesagt, sie und ihre Mitinsassen seien krank geworden, in Ohnmacht gefallen und hätten verzweifelt versucht, sich abzukühlen. Es sei »üblich« gewesen, sich zur Abkühlung mit Wasser aus der Toilette zu bespritzen. »Das sind keine menschenwürdigen Haftbedingungen«, urteilte der Richter.
Klimaanlagen sind in dem südlichen Bundesstaat Standard in Wohnhäusern, Büros und Geschäften.
Geklagt hatte eine Gruppe von Bürgerrechtsorganisationen gemeinsam mit Insassen oder deren Vertretern. Ihre Klage richtete sich gegen die für die Gefängnisse des Bundesstaates zuständige Behörde. Daneben gibt es auch privat oder vom Bund betriebene Gefängnisse, in denen jedoch deutlich weniger Häftlinge einsitzen.
Der Bundesrichter in Austin sah es als erwiesen an, dass die Verhältnisse der texanischen Gefängnisse gegen den achten Zusatzartikel der Verfassung verstoßen. Der Artikel untersagt »grausame und ungewöhnliche Strafen«. Die Justizbehörde muss dem Gericht nun alle sechs Monate darlegen, wie es mit Planung und Installation der Anlagen vorangeht. Finanzielle Belastungen seien ausdrücklich kein Grund, die Klimatisierung hinauszuzögern.
Laut dem Nachrichtenportal »Texas Tribune« könnten Kosten von 1,5 Milliarden Dollar entstehen.

title: HOT LUNCH | How Abigail Rands is redefining Cap Classique
content:
The embodiment of Joburg’s food heritage, Andrea Burgener and Nick Gordon have set up an impromptu table at The Leopard especially for us, which feels like an act of considerable friendship because The Leopard, that beloved Joburg institution of excellent ingredients, irreverence and food that tastes resolutely of itself, is no longer operating as a conventional restaurant but rather as a glorious food emporium.
We are here because Abigail Rands, CEO of Krone, is collaborating with Andrea and Nick on a series of lunches later this year, bringing together compatible philosophies: good wine, good food, good farming and the conviction that the best things begin with what comes out of the earth.
Rands grew up in Franschhoek “when it was still a little town”, left home at 18 and promptly disappeared into the world. Indonesia came first, then London and Italy, where she studied fashion design at Polimoda in Florence before moving into luxury goods and working in branding and marketing at Ferragamo.
It is, in retrospect, an unusually good apprenticeship for running a South African wine estate.
“I think what I really brought back from Italy was this understanding of building a brand with cultural relevance,” she says. “I loved wine, but I also loved art. I thought, how am I going to bring these two passions together?”
She returned to South Africa in 2012 under circumstances that would radically alter the course of her life. Her father had recently bought Twee Jonge Gezellen, home of Krone, at auction, apparently beating his rival bidder by around R200,000.
“He bought it on a wing and a prayer,” she says.
I needed to really earn respect, and that took me 10 years and making a success of Krone
— Abigail Rands
Rands had come home because her father was unwell. Within six months, he was dead. He was 63. She was 27.
Suddenly, the young woman who had been working in Italian luxury was responsible for a historic Tulbagh wine estate.
“We just had to get in and figure it out. We started from scratch. The wheels could have come off a few times.”
Wine farms, she points out, are wonderful repositories for money if your ambition is never to see that money again. There has been a decade of renovation, replanting ageing vineyards and continual reinvestment.
“How do you get a small wine farm?” I ask.
“Start with a big one,” she laughs.
What she inherited from her father was less a blueprint than an instinct. A lawyer who quickly realised he did not want to practise law, he became a wine entrepreneur with a gift for identifying emerging regions, winemakers and ideas. Rands remembers wine labels scattered across the kitchen counter at breakfast, conversations about capsules, typography and bottles, and an education absorbed almost by osmosis.
“He taught me to be bold and not be afraid to make mistakes. Just do it. A real can-do attitude.”
Being a 27-year-old woman stepping into her father’s shoes in an old farming industry required some mettle.
“I needed to really earn respect, and that took me 10 years and making a success of Krone.”
Her Italian years gave her the language with which to turn instinct into identity. Art became embedded in Krone through collaborations, exhibitions and an artist residency. Yet Rands is adamant that all the lovely cultural architecture surrounding the brand remains secondary to what is in the bottle.
“We are very focused on wine. That comes first.”
For her, winemaking itself is design. “You begin with soil, then cultivar, aspect, slope and sun. You decide which parcels belong in which wines. In the cellar, Krone experiments with fermentation vessels and keeps an archive of vintages, releasing some years later as recently disgorged (RD) wines.”
“It’s a total design process,” she says. “You design the vineyard.”
And then nature comes along and redesigns it for you. Climate change is already altering harvest. Krone traditionally begins picking in early January; Rands says this season they expect to start in December.
You suddenly have the perspective of an 80-year-old at 39. It’s fine. It’s all fine
— Abigail Rands
Her response is characteristically philosophical: “You work with nature. You work with what you’re given.”
Krone produces vintage Cap Classique rather than smoothing different years into a consistent non-vintage house style. “We work with what that place and time has given us, and with those nuances. We’re not afraid of them.”
Perhaps that equanimity comes from growing up barefoot on farms, riding horses and being attuned to the seasons. Perhaps some of it arrived more recently. Last year, Rands was diagnosed with thyroid cancer.
She underwent surgery and describes an intense year of therapy and recovery. The experience, she says, rearranged her sense of what deserves anxiety.
“You suddenly have the perspective of an 80-year-old at 39. It’s fine. It’s all fine.”
The older she gets, the more everything seems to circle back to family. “Family is everything.”
Her mother studied fine art, archaeology and museum sciences and gave her an eye for objects and history. Her 96-year-old grandmother still lives about a kilometre away and runs her honey business, Champagne Honey, from the same gloriously unruly farm.
The name once provoked a legal challenge from Champagne in France. Her grandmother won. “It’s in the blood.”
Rands now wants Krone to become a globally significant Cap Classique brand. It is already exported to around 18 countries, with strong markets in Scandinavia, Britain, the Netherlands, Japan, the Baltics and elsewhere in Europe.
“I think there is a huge opportunity for us to compete with Champagne,” she says. “I want to see more really good Cap Classique on South African tables instead of Champagne. We don’t want to be Champagne. We want to be Cap Classique.”

title: In the 1930s, Periyar Argued Women Needed Contraception for One Reason: Freedom
content:
On 17 September, as Tamil Nadu marks Periya’s 148th birth anniversary, one 1930 essay stands out. In it, Periyar argued that women needed contraception, not for health or population reasons, but for personal freedom and true independence.
That single reason set him apart from every other reformer of his era. Where others cited maternal health or family property, Periyar wrote that repeated childbirth wore women down and chained them to domestic life.
But freedom, for Periyar, could not stop at the body. He argued women would stay dependent as long as they relied on husbands for money, and demanded property rights and paid work for every woman.
The argument grew bolder still. Periyar turned his pen on marriage itself, publicly condemning customs that reduced wives to their husbands' property, and defending a woman's right to walk away and end a marriage entirely.
A year later, in 1931, Kudi Arasu carried an essay naming real dangers, pregnancies begun before a body recovered from a previous birth, and pregnancies among ill women, in the medical language of his era.
None of this stayed private. Periyar had built Kudi Arasu himself, and used its pages again and again to push these arguments before readers across Tamil Nadu, never once softening them for anyone who read.
The man behind these words had barely finished school. Periyar read and wrote obsessively for decades, and this vast body of work now survives almost entirely, preserved and carefully digitised in the Periyar Archive today.
Nagammai, remembered mostly as his wife, organised campaigns, appeared in public, and shaped Kudi Arasu's own work from within, not from the sidelines of a movement he led alone
Cambridge scholars studying his work now see something larger than one campaign. Periyar's thinking moved past formal equality toward personal, sexual and reproductive freedom, with contraception as a single thread in a much wider argument.
Nearly a century before reproductive rights entered mainstream conversation, Periyar was already asking who controls a woman's body. On his 148th birth anniversary, that question still waits for a fuller answer than it got then.

title: Meuze Atelier, deux soeurs dans un même sac: "Tout est du seconde main, sauf la boucle!" (Photos)
content:
Meuze Atelier, deux soeurs dans un même sac: "Tout est du seconde main, sauf la boucle!" (Photos)
Eva et Louise Ridremont sont sœurs et désormais associées. Elles ont créé une ligne de sacs en tissu de seconde main.
- Publié le 23-09-2026 à 16h20
L'une travaille dans un centre d'accueil pour réfugiés, l'autre dans la communication. Rien ne présageait que Eva et Louise Ridremont se retrouvent autour d'une aventure entrepreneuriale commune, encore moins autour des sacs en tissu de seconde main. "En fait, on a toujours parlé de lancer quelque chose ensemble, entre sœurs, sans savoir quoi, quelque chose qui respecte une certaine éthique et qui soit localisé à Namur" lance Louise, la plus jeune du duo.
Elles avaient plus d'une idée dans leur sac, mais aucune n'a abouti. C'est alors qu'elles ont observé dans les rues namuroises les nombreux tote bags, ces sacs en tissu à deux anses, utiles pour les petites courses, transporter un ordinateur, des dossiers. "Sauf qu'on voyait des personnes qui en transportaient trois à la fois, un pour chaque fonction ! Et aucun ne vient de Namur, ce sont des sacs importés d'on ne sait où, fabriqués dans des conditions qu'on ne connaît pas et distribués un peu partout. On s'est alors dit, tiens pourquoi ne pas tout réunir en un seul sac, sur le modèle du tote bag, cousu à la main ici à Namur ?" raconte Louise.
Meuze atelier est né. Un patronyme qui rappelle la ville de cœur des deux sœurs, avec un changement de consonne pour éviter d'être confondu avec un fleuve.
+ Intéressé par les informations sur la durabilité, l'environnement, le vivant, la biodiversité, le climat, et les solutions innovantes venues de nos régions ? Inscrivez-vous à notre newsletter "Vert", qui rassemble des infos de chez nous et du monde entier.
L'éthique au cœur du sac
Eva et Louise ont lancé une enquête marketing afin de sonder leur potentielle clientèle avant l'heure du premier lâcher de sacs. "Pour nous l'éthique est importante. Au niveau social et environnemental, on voulait un sac éthique. Pourtant, dans les enquêtes marketing, c'était souvent un critère en bas de classement, les gens veulent surtout un sac pratique et qui tient dans la durée" souligne Eva.
Les sœurs ont suivi les recommandations de leurs futurs clients, excepté sur les valeurs, sur lesquelles elles ne transigent pas. Les sacs sont entièrement cousus à la main, à partir de tissu chiné, et assemblés selon les principes de l'économie sociale.
La manufacture est située à Bouge, dans les locaux de Repair and Wear Studio, un atelier de textile et de retouches axé sur la revalorisation de tissu de seconde main. "C'est une coopérative qui travaille avec des personnes en réinsertion professionnelle, c'est cohérent avec notre projet" insiste Eva. Ce processus rend chaque sac unique, personnalisé. "Nous chinons un peu partout à la recherche de tissus pour nos sacs. Nous avons dû apprendre à reconnaître les tissus qui ont une maille adaptée" précise Louise. Meuze Atelier garantit les sacs à vie.
Une vente par "drop"
Les sacs Meuze ont été pensés pour être ergonomiques. Ils sont assez larges pour accueillir un ordinateur, des dossiers, des effets personnels. Ils contiennent une pochette extérieure, un cordon porte-clés, une poche zippée en intérieur et une fermeture aimantée. "Seule la boucle n'est pas de seconde main, on n'arrive pas encore à en trouver d'occasion" précise Louise.
Les sacs sont vendus aux alentours de 119 euros selon un système de "drop" et de liste d'attente, soit des ventes planifiées avec un nombre prédéfini de sacs disponibles.
Lors du premier drop, fin août, onze heureux ont trouvé sac à leurs épaules. "Nous ne gagnons pas vraiment notre vie avec ces sacs. Si on veut de la rentabilité, on doit les vendre à 250 euros, mais on aurait été mal à l'aise d'en demander tant" sourit Louise. "On explique sur notre site pourquoi nous avons fixé ce prix, comment nous travaillons, on veut être les plus transparentes possible" ajoute Eva. Meuze porte cette promesse, que le client n'achète pas un chat dans un sac.
Prochain "drop" le 28 septembre - toutes les infos: www. meuze-atelier.be

title: Centralized Multidisciplinary Retinoblastoma Care Closes the Outcome Gap: Survival and Globe Salvage for 1000 Eyes from 601 Patients.
content: Retinoblastoma (RB) outcomes in low- and middle-income countries remain inferior to those achieved in high-income countries, largely due to delayed diagnosis, limited access to specialized care, and fragmented treatment systems. The aim of this study is to evaluate the long-term impact of a two-decade strategy based on centralized multidisciplinary care, structured capacity building, and a telemedicine-supported international twinning partnership in reducing disparities in retinoblastoma (RB) outcomes in a resource-limited setting. Retrospective, single-center cohort study. 601 children with RB (1000 affected eyes) treated at King Hussein Cancer Center (KHCC) between March 2003 and December 2025. Demographic characteristics, tumor classification, treatment modalities, globe salvage, metastasis, secondary malignancies, and survival outcomes were reviewed. Overall survival was estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method. Globe salvage rate, rates of metastasis and secondary malignancy, and 5-year overall survival. Of 601 children, 314 (52%) were male, 399 (66%) had bilateral disease, and 346 (58%) were non-Jordanian, referred from 15 countries. Of 1000 affected eyes, 120 (12%) were enucleated before referral; among the remaining eyes, 7 (0.7%) had extraocular disease, and by International Classification, 52 (5.2%) were Group A, 134 (13%) Group B, 204 (20%) Group C, 391 (39%) Group D, and 92 (9.2%) Group E. Of 880 eyes treated at KHCC, primary enucleation was performed in 157 (18%), and conservative eye-salvage therapy was attempted in 723 (82%). Among the 723 eyes that underwent eye-salvaging treatment, systemic chemotherapy was administered in 713 (99%), transpupillary thermo therapy (TTT) in all 723 (100%), cryotherapy in 248 (34%), intra-arterial chemotherapy in 34 (4.7%; 11 primary and 23 secondary), intravitreal chemotherapy in 43 (5.9%), subtenon chemotherapy in 24 (3.3%), and iodine-125 plaque brachytherapy in 23 (3.2%). Ten Group A eyes in 10 patients were treated with TTT and/or cryotherapy alone without systemic chemotherapy. Overall eye salvage rate was 61% (538/880); among conservatively treated eyes, salvage rate was 74.4% (538/723), ranging from 98% (Group A) to 17% (Group E). At median follow-up of 120 months, metastasis occurred in 26 patients (4.3%) and secondary malignancy in 7 (1.2%). Estimated 5-year overall survival was 96% (95% CI, 94%-98%). A centralized multidisciplinary RB program integrating telemedicine, international collaboration, and advanced globe-salvage therapies achieved survival and eye-preservation outcomes comparable to high-income settings despite resource constraints. Over two decades, KHCC evolved into a major regional referral center, offering a scalable model for reducing global disparities in RB care. None.

title: Collboni anuncia la apertura de comercios asequibles en Barcelona tras reunirse con Zohran Mamdani
content: Los primeros ediles de Barcelona y Nueva York han compartido impresiones y experiencias sobre vivienda, turismo, pobreza y climaSánchez compartirá con Mamdani un acto sobre una “economía para la mayoría” en Nueva York El alcalde de Barcelona, Jaume Collboni, se ha reunido este sábado con el de Nueva York, Zohran Mamdami, donde han compartido experiencias mutuas en políticas de vivienda, cooperación internacional entre ciudades, resiliencia climática y ayudas públicas para el suministro de alimentos. Inspirado en la experiencia de la ciudad norteamericana, Collboni ha anunciado que Barcelona iniciará la apertura de supermercados asequibles, trasladando a Europa la experiencia neoyorquina impulsada por Mamdami. Según aseguró el barcelonés, la implantación de estas tiendas comenzará por el barrio de la Marina y tendrá como objetivo “garantizar bienes básicos de primera necesidad de forma asequible para las familias trabajadoras y las clases medias”. El comercio estará gestionado por una ONG, dentro de un edificio municipal. El proyecto también se vinculará a un programa de formación profesional. La propuesta de los comercios con productos de precios ajustados fue una de las ideas que el alcalde demócrata lanzó durante su campaña electoral en Nueva York. El encuentro bilateral que han protagonizado Collboni y Mamdani se ha mantenido en paralelo a la cumbre de ciudades U20, que se celebra en la ciudad estadounidense estos días. Collboni y Mamdami coincidieron en la importancia de las relaciones entre grandes ciudades en un momento de tensión internacional. Al finalizar, el alcalde barcelonés ha dicho que ambos mandatarios están convencidos de que “en un momento en el que las democracias en muchos países están amenazadas y donde el multilateralismo es atacado y menospreciado también por muchos de estos países, es más importante que nunca que las ciudades del mundo tengan contacto, intercambio de informaciones, y activen todas las redes internacionales que esté”. Uno de los grandes retos de las grandes ciudades es el de la vivienda. Collboni explicó a su homólogo la regulación de los precios del alquiler y la futura prohibición de los pisos turísticos. Sobre resiliencia climática, Mamdami se ha interesado por el plan de climatización de escuelas de Barcelona, pagado con la tasa turística. Cumbre de grandes ciudades Collboni tiene previsto participar participará en toda una serie de reuniones y sesiones públicas y de trabajo, junto con la comisionada de Asuntos Europeos del Ayuntamiento de Barcelona, Mar Jiménez, con el objetivo de afianzar el liderazgo de Barcelona en el ámbito internacional en la lucha por garantizar el derecho de acceso a la vivienda. La cumbre de ciudades U20 se celebra en Nueva York del 19 al 21 de septiembre. En la edición de este año las tres prioridades clave, sujetas a debate y acuerdo por parte de todas las ciudades participantes del U20 serán la vivienda asequible y el sinhogarismo; la acción climática, la sostenibilidad y la resiliencia; y la protección de las comunidades inmigrantes y la movilidad humana. De esta cumbre surgirá un documento de conclusiones y propuestas, el llamado 'Communiqué', a fin de que las ciudades les entreguen a sus jefes de gobierno y de Estado y que lo tengan en consideración para la próxima reunión de la plataforma G20 que se celebrará en diciembre en Miami. Este domingo, el alcalde participará en la sesión 'Vivienda, asequibilidad y el derecho a quedarse', que encabeza junto con la jefa de gobierno de Ciudad de México, Clara Brugada, y donde ambos harán valer políticas de vivienda que están impulsando en sus ciudades. También participarán representantes municipales de Nueva York, Roma, San Diego, Rotterdam y Los Angeles. En este panel el alcalde compartirá las principales políticas de vivienda que se están llevando a cabo en la ciudad de Barcelona, sus efectos y defenderá el derecho a quedarse de los vecinos en las ciudades. Un encuentro de ciudades para influir en las decisiones de los Estados del G20 Fundada en 2018, Urban20 (U20) es una plataforma de diplomacia urbana que reúne anualmente las principales ciudades de los países miembros del G20, con el objetivo de compartir y crear recomendaciones políticas para los líderes del G20 sobre aspectos como la economía, el clima y el urbanismo sostenible. La iniciativa U20 está convocada de forma permanente por C40 Cities -una red global de alcaldes- y Ciudades y Gobiernos Locales Unidos (CGLU), bajo el liderazgo de una o dos ciudades de acogida, que cambian cada año. Este año, son las ciudades de Nueva York y Los Angeles. Nueva York acoge ahora la cumbre de alcaldes, mientras Los Angeles acogió la reunión de equipos técnicos (sherpa meeting) el 11 y 12 de mayo. En esta edición de la cumbre del U20, participarán alcaldes y representantes de 38 ciudades. Aparte de Barcelona, participan: Amsterdam, Atlanta, Boston, Bristol, Buenos Aires, Chicago, Copenhague, Denver, Freetown, Manchester, Helsinki, Estambul, Esmirna, Yakarta, Johannesburgo, Kitchener, Konya, Londres, Los Ángeles, Ciudad de México, Miami, Milán, Montreal, Nueva York, París, Chile, Sao Paulo, Seattle, La Haya, Tokio, Turín, Toronto y Tshwane.

title: 'Today, a Khan and a Singh won a medal for India': Satnam on Asian Games bronze
content:
NEW DELHI: Satnam Singh and
Salman Khan won India's first-ever Asian Games medal in men's double sculls on Thursday, with the Indian pair claiming bronze at the Nagaragawa International Regatta Course.
But for Satnam, the medal meant much more than a place on the podium.
"Today, a Khan and a Singh won a medal for India. I want people to remember that. Long after we are gone, this fact will live on. Salman is like a brother to me. There are things we hear and read about, and that disturbs us. I want our people to stop fighting on religious lines," Satnam told HT.
The pair clocked 6:13.25 to finish third. China's Yi Xudi and Nie Yide won gold in 6:09.77, while Uzbekistan's Mekhrojbek Mamatkulov and Pavel Sorin took silver in 6:10.49. Satnam and Salman were second at the 1,500m mark but slipped to third in the final 500m.
A medal that brought two journeys together
Satnam and Salman had originally been selected for the quadruple sculls team along with Jakar Khan and Balraj Panwar. However, after a change in the team combinations, the duo was moved to the double sculls event in place of Navdeep Singh and Kulwinder Singh.
Satnam admitted the change did affect them, but the two decided to focus on giving their best.
"I won't say we were not affected by it, but we decided to give our best. It helped that me and Salman have been training together for seven months for quadruple sculls, so we had good understanding," Satnam said.
He also felt the conditions helped them.
"The tailwind helped us today and the waters were still. We were the lightest finalists, which helped us go faster. Both of us weigh about 85kgs each while the rest of the rowers were in 90-95kg range."
Satnam's road to the podium
For Satnam, the bronze also helped erase the disappointment of the previous Asian Games. China and Uzbekistan had won gold and silver in the event at the previous edition, although with different rowers. Satnam, who had competed with Parminder Singh, had finished last among six pairs in Hangzhou.
"The failure in Hangzhou had haunted me all these years and I was waiting for this Asiad to redeem myself. I was also part of the quadruple team that won a bronze there. We were on course for a silver in 2023 but I was exhausted and passed out which had cost us a second-place result. So all that weighed heavy on me coming into the competition," Satnam said.
The 26-year-old comes from Fatta Maluka village in Punjab's Mansa district and is employed in the Indian Navy as a Chief Petty Officer. A former national-level handball player, Satnam also played volleyball before taking up rowing. He was inspired by London Olympian Swarn Singh Virk, who also comes from Mansa.
"I was into multiple sports at school, and once my PT teacher invited Swarn Singh to our school to have a word with kids. Swarn comes from Mansa as well, so he was an instant inspiration," Satnam recalled.
Swarn encouraged him to take up rowing, and Satnam joined the Punjab Institute of Sports in Ropar, where he began training under Virjender Singh Cheema.
Satnam joined the Navy in 2019 through the sports quota and later trained at SAI centres in Odisha and Alleppey.
A promise to his mother
Satnam grew up in a family with limited means. His father, Amrik Singh, grew cotton on their farm, while his mother Harjeet Kaur tailored clothes to support the family. His brother Gurpiar Singh, a soldier with the 28 Punjab Regiment based in Jammu, supported his early training. Satnam later joined the Army Rowing Node in Pune in 2022.
"I am happy to have given them something to cheer about after all these years. I had promised my mom that I'll make up for that Hangzhou heartbreak. I am happy to have done that," he said.
Satnam is also proud of his roots and the athletes who have come from Mansa.
"There is something about Mansa that it produces strong people. Swarn Singh and double Asiad medallist rower Sukhmeet Singh are also from here. A lot of our boys join the army," he said.
Late Punjabi singer Siddhu Moosewala was another of Satnam's heroes.
"He remains an absolute star. I listen to his songs while warming-up," he said.
From driving an Uber to an Asian Games medal
Salman's journey to the Asian Games podium has also been shaped by struggle. Born in Pure Dhingai in Uttar Pradesh's Amethi, Salman is the eldest of four brothers and two sisters. His father, Mohd Kasim Khan, worked in a truck-body construction company in Tauru, Haryana, where Salman completed his schooling.
His life changed when his father died of dengue when Salman was 18. He then drove an Uber in Delhi to support his family before joining the Bombay Engineering Group of the Indian Army in 2018.
It was there that Salman discovered rowing. His 6'4" frame and raw power caught the attention of coaches, and he began training at the Army Rowing Node under senior coach Kudrat Ali and Training Officer Major Nagendra Hooda.
"It feels like a dream come true. I was expecting to win a medal at the Asian Games, and I am delighted that I could fulfil that expectation. But this is only the beginning; my next target is the Los Angeles Olympics," Salman, a Naib Subedar in the Army, said.
"I know what struggle means in life, but I never lost hope. I kept working hard and continued to believe in myself."

title: Argentina y Uruguay brillaron en el Mundial de Carnes 2026 y concentraron las medallas de oro en Buenos Aires
content:
Argentina y Uruguay fueron protagonistas de la segunda edición del Campeonato Mundial de Carnes 2026, realizada el 17 de septiembre en el restaurante El Central de La Rural, en Palermo. Más de 200 muestras compitieron en las categorías de bife ancho y bife angosto, dentro de un proceso de evaluación que comenzó durante la denominada Semana de la Calidad y terminó con la jura final en Buenos Aires.
“El proceso de jura empezó el fin de semana anterior en 20 restaurantes en distintos lugares del país y se completó el jueves pasado en el restaurante central de La Rural, en Palermo”, explicó Luis Barcos, fundador y director de la Escuela de Sommelier de Carnes de Argentina.
Terneza, jugosidad y sabor
El sistema busca evitar que la preparación distorsione la comparación entre los cortes. “Lo que evaluaba era la terneza, la jugosidad y el sabor”, detalló Barcos, quien agregó que “todas las muestras estaban cocinadas de la misma manera, con la misma temperatura y al mismo tiempo”.
La organización informó que el proceso completo involucró alrededor de 1.000 jurados, entre chefs, sommeliers, especialistas y consumidores entrenados. “Queríamos que lo que se evalúe fuese la calidad en sí de la muestra y no la forma de cocción”, explicó Barcos sobre una evaluación realizada a ciegas y registrada mediante una aplicación.
El sabor tuvo además reconocimientos específicos. “Quisimos también realzar el tema del sabor para ponerlo sobre la mesa, no solo que se hable de la terneza”, sostuvo Barcos, quien mencionó distinciones para muestras de México, Argentina y Uruguay.
Pasto y grano, dos perfiles diferentes
Los bifes fueron divididos también según el sistema de alimentación. “Se jura por separado lo que proviene de animales alimentados a pasto y lo que proviene de animales que tienen una terminación con concentrado, granos u otro tipo de aporte energético”, explicó.
Esa diferencia se refleja directamente en las características sensoriales. “La intensidad y la persistencia de una carne de animales producida a pasto es diferente, es más persistente y más intensa en general”, señaló Barcos.
También aparecen cambios visibles en el producto. “El pasto colorea la grasa, lo que se llaman los carotenos, y varía esa intensidad según el tiempo de pastoreo, el tipo de pasto, si es primavera o verano”, detalló.
Una medalla que también tiene impacto comercial
Los ganadores pueden utilizar el sello oficial de la competencia en sus productos y campañas. “Es una marca registrada y ellos lo pueden usar libremente en todo su esquema de comercio, distribución y promoción”, explicó Barcos.
El organizador recordó el impacto que tuvieron las medallas de la primera edición. “El año pasado ganó Perú una medalla de oro y fue un antes y un después, no solo para él, sino para el Perú”, contó sobre un productor que además tenía restaurantes y que, según relató, pasó a recibir reservas durante meses.
La repercusión también alcanzó directamente a los establecimientos ganaderos. “Me empezaban a llamar y decir: quiero tu carne, quiero tu carne, ¿con quién hablo?”, recordó Barcos al describir lo ocurrido con productores de Argentina y Uruguay después de ser premiados.
Del campo al consumidor
Para el responsable del certamen, uno de los objetivos es identificar cada eslabón que participa en la calidad final. “Todas las muestras tienen que informar de qué estancia provienen, qué raza es, cómo fueron alimentados y el tipo de corte”, explicó.
“Conocemos la información hasta el origen del producto, que es lo que perseguimos: visibilizar toda la cadena”, sostuvo Barcos. La edición 2026 reunió muestras de Argentina, Brasil, Uruguay, Paraguay, Bolivia, Panamá, México, España, Inglaterra e Irlanda, según la información final de la organización.
El balance, aseguró, fue positivo también por la diversidad de participantes. “En las mesas se unía la cadena: teníamos chefs, cocineros, carniceros, sommeliers, la industria e importadores de carne”, afirmó Barcos, quien anticipó que el próximo objetivo será “mejorar aún más esa sinergia entre todas las partes que componen la cadena de la carne”.

title: Incendios en Quito dejan 278 animales atendidos por la Unidad de Bienestar Animal
content:
Fecha de publicación:
Fecha de modificación:
La emergencia por los incendios forestales en Quito dejó 278 animales atendidos por equipos veterinarios de la Unidad de Bienestar Animal (UBA). Los profesionales realizaron controles de salud y atención veterinaria primaria en dos de las zonas afectadas por el fuego: el cerro Casitagua y La Vicentina.
Del total de animales atendidos, 265 recibieron atención en Casitagua y otros 13 en La Vicentina. Los equipos también recorrieron los sectores cercanos a los incendios para identificar animales que podían encontrarse en riesgo y orientaron a sus tutores sobre las medidas para mantenerlos seguros mientras duraba la emergencia.
En el cerro Casitagua, el incendio afectó aproximadamente 300 hectáreas. Los veterinarios de la UBA trabajaron durante todo el fin de semana y recorrieron los sectores afectados para localizar animales que pudieran necesitar atención o encontrarse en peligro.
Durante estas jornadas, los equipos encontraron a la mayoría de animales asustados y nerviosos por las llamas y el humo. Ante esta situación, los profesionales recomendaron a los tutores mantener a sus animales en lugares seguros. De preferencia, dentro de sus hogares.
La recomendación buscó reducir el riesgo de que los animales escaparan, se extraviaran o se desorientaran durante la emergencia. El humo y la presencia del fuego generaron condiciones que podían alterar su comportamiento, por lo que la UBA centró parte de su trabajo en verificar su estado y orientar a quienes estaban a su cargo.
Los equipos veterinarios también realizaron un rescate durante su intervención en Casitagua. Una hembra recién parida permanecía junto a sus nueve cachorros. El personal de la UBA trasladó a la madre y a sus crías a uno de los centros de la institución municipal.
En ese lugar, los animales reciben atención veterinaria y permanecen bajo cuidado. La intervención permitió que la hembra y sus nueve cachorros quedaran bajo supervisión del personal de la Unidad de Bienestar Animal.
La UBA también desplegó atención veterinaria en La Vicentina. En este sector, los equipos atendieron a 13 animales afectados principalmente por la presencia de humo.
Los profesionales realizaron evaluaciones físicas y controles para conocer el estado de salud de los animales. De esta manera, la atención se concentró en revisar posibles afectaciones relacionadas con las condiciones generadas por el incendio.
En ambos sectores, el trabajo de los equipos veterinarios incluyó la verificación de las condiciones de salud de los animales que permanecían en las zonas afectadas o en sus alrededores. Además, los profesionales entregaron recomendaciones a los tutores para protegerlos mientras continuaba la emergencia.
La Unidad de Bienestar Animal mantiene su articulación con las entidades municipales para responder ante situaciones de emergencia. Estas acciones buscan fortalecer la protección y el bienestar de los animales en el Distrito Metropolitano de Quito.
